# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) solver for day-ahead base case.
Implements the complex-power formulation from math-model.md using Pyomo + IPOPT.

MATPOWER column conventions (0-indexed):
  bus:     [BUS_I, TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN]
  gen:     [GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, STATUS, PMAX, PMIN]
  branch:  [F_BUS, T_BUS, R, X, B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX]
  gencost: [MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, c2, c1, c0]  (for polynomial model=2, ncost=3)
"""

import json
import math
import numpy as np
from pyomo.environ import (
    ConcreteModel, Set, Param, Var, Objective, Constraint,
    minimize, value, SolverFactory, TerminationCondition,
    NonNegativeReals, Reals, RangeSet, log, sqrt, sin, cos, atan2
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.  Load data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
with open("/root/network.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

baseMVA = data["baseMVA"]
bus_data = data["bus"]
gen_data = data["gen"]
branch_data = data["branch"]
gencost_data = data["gencost"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.  Parse into convenient dicts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
buses = {}
for row in bus_data:
    i = int(row[0])
    buses[i] = {
        "type": int(row[1]),
        "pd": row[2],       # MW
        "qd": row[3],       # MVAr
        "gs": row[4],       # MW (shunt conductance at 1 pu V)
        "bs": row[5],       # MVAr (shunt susceptance at 1 pu V)
        "vm0": row[7],
        "va0": row[8],
        "vmax": row[11],
        "vmin": row[12],
    }

bus_ids = sorted(buses.keys())
ref_buses = [i for i in bus_ids if buses[i]["type"] == 3]

gens = {}
gens_at_bus = {}
for k, row in enumerate(gen_data):
    bus_i = int(row[0])
    status = int(row[7])
    if status == 0:
        continue
    gens[k] = {
        "bus": bus_i,
        "pg0": row[1],
        "qg0": row[2],
        "qmax": row[3],
        "qmin": row[4],
        "vg": row[5],
        "pmax": row[8],
        "pmin": row[9],
    }
    gens_at_bus.setdefault(bus_i, []).append(k)

# Parse gencost (polynomial model type 2, NCOST=3 => c2, c1, c0)
gen_costs = {}
for k, row in enumerate(gencost_data):
    if k not in gens:
        continue
    model_type = int(row[0])
    ncost = int(row[3])
    if model_type == 2 and ncost == 3:
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": row[4], "c1": row[5], "c0": row[6]}
    elif model_type == 2 and ncost == 2:
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": 0.0, "c1": row[4], "c0": row[5]}
    else:
        # fallback
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": 0.0, "c1": 0.0, "c0": 0.0}

branches = {}
for idx, row in enumerate(branch_data):
    status = int(row[10])
    if status == 0:
        continue
    f = int(row[0])
    t = int(row[1])
    r = row[2]
    x = row[3]
    b_ch = row[4]
    rate_a = row[5]
    tap = row[8]
    shift_deg = row[9]
    angmin = row[11]
    angmax = row[12]

    # Handle tap=0 meaning no transformer (tap=1)
    if tap == 0.0:
        tap = 1.0

    branches[idx] = {
        "f": f, "t": t,
        "r": r, "x": x, "b": b_ch,
        "rate_a": rate_a,
        "tap": tap, "shift": shift_deg,
        "angmin": angmin, "angmax": angmax,
    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.  Compute branch admittance parameters (pi-model)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For a branch (i,j) with series impedance z = r + jx, total charging b,
# tap ratio tap, and phase shift theta:
#   Y_ij = 1/z  (series admittance)
#   Y^c_ij = j*b/2  (from-side charging -- modified by tap for transformers)
#   Y^c_ji = j*b/2  (to-side charging)
#   T_ij = tap * exp(j*shift)
#
# The math-model.md flow equations:
#   S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |Vi|^2 / |T_ij|^2  - conj(Y_ij) * Vi*conj(Vj)/T_ij
#   S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |Vj|^2              - conj(Y_ij) * conj(Vi)*Vj/conj(T_ij)
#
# In rectangular admittance form (g+jb), with V = Vm*exp(j*va):
#   P_ij and Q_ij can be written in terms of Vm_i, Vm_j, va_i, va_j

for idx in branches:
    br = branches[idx]
    r, x = br["r"], br["x"]
    z_mag_sq = r*r + x*x
    if z_mag_sq < 1e-20:
        z_mag_sq = 1e-20
    g_s = r / z_mag_sq   # series conductance
    b_s = -x / z_mag_sq  # series susceptance

    b_ch = br["b"]       # total line charging
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift_rad = math.radians(br["shift"])

    # Store pre-computed values
    br["g_s"] = g_s
    br["b_s"] = b_s
    br["b_ch"] = b_ch
    br["tap_mag"] = tap
    br["shift_rad"] = shift_rad
    br["tap_mag_sq"] = tap * tap


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.  Build Pyomo Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
m = ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

# --- Sets ---
m.BUS = Set(initialize=bus_ids)
m.GEN = Set(initialize=sorted(gens.keys()))
m.BRANCH = Set(initialize=sorted(branches.keys()))
m.REF = Set(initialize=ref_buses)

# --- Variables ---
# Voltage magnitude and angle
def vm_init(m, i):
    return buses[i]["vm0"] if buses[i]["vm0"] > 0 else 1.0

def va_init(m, i):
    return math.radians(buses[i]["va0"])

m.Vm = Var(m.BUS, within=NonNegativeReals, initialize=vm_init)
m.Va = Var(m.BUS, within=Reals, initialize=va_init)

for i in m.BUS:
    m.Vm[i].setlb(buses[i]["vmin"])
    m.Vm[i].setub(buses[i]["vmax"])

# Generator real and reactive power (in per-unit)
def pg_init(m, k):
    return gens[k]["pg0"] / baseMVA

def qg_init(m, k):
    return gens[k]["qg0"] / baseMVA

m.Pg = Var(m.GEN, within=Reals, initialize=pg_init)
m.Qg = Var(m.GEN, within=Reals, initialize=qg_init)

for k in m.GEN:
    m.Pg[k].setlb(gens[k]["pmin"] / baseMVA)
    m.Pg[k].setub(gens[k]["pmax"] / baseMVA)
    m.Qg[k].setlb(gens[k]["qmin"] / baseMVA)
    m.Qg[k].setub(gens[k]["qmax"] / baseMVA)

# --- Objective: minimize generation cost ---
# cost = c2*(Pg*baseMVA)^2 + c1*(Pg*baseMVA) + c0
# Note: Pg is in pu, costs expect MW
def obj_rule(m):
    return sum(
        gen_costs[k]["c2"] * (m.Pg[k]*baseMVA)**2 +
        gen_costs[k]["c1"] * (m.Pg[k]*baseMVA) +
        gen_costs[k]["c0"]
        for k in m.GEN
    )
m.obj = Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=minimize)

# --- Reference bus angle = 0 ---
def ref_angle_rule(m, r):
    return m.Va[r] == 0.0
m.ref_angle = Constraint(m.REF, rule=ref_angle_rule)

# --- Power balance constraints ---
# At each bus i:
#   sum(Pg_k for k in G_i) - Pd_i/baseMVA - gs_i/baseMVA * Vm_i^2
#     = sum of P_ij for all branches incident to i
#   sum(Qg_k for k in G_i) - Qd_i/baseMVA + bs_i/baseMVA * Vm_i^2
#     = sum of Q_ij for all branches incident to i

# Pre-compute bus-to-branch incidence
bus_branches_from = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}  # branches where i is "from"
bus_branches_to = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}    # branches where i is "to"
for idx in branches:
    br = branches[idx]
    bus_branches_from[br["f"]].append(idx)
    bus_branches_to[br["t"]].append(idx)


def Pflow_from(m, idx):
    """Real power flow from bus f on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap2 = br["tap_mag_sq"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ij = m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift
    # P_ij = (g_s + 0) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(theta) + b_s*sin(theta))
    return (g_s) * m.Vm[i]**2 / tap2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * cos(theta_ij) + b_s * sin(theta_ij))


def Qflow_from(m, idx):
    """Reactive power flow from bus f on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap2 = br["tap_mag_sq"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ij = m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift
    # Q_ij = -(b_s + b_ch/2) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(theta) - b_s*cos(theta))
    return -(b_s + b_ch/2) * m.Vm[i]**2 / tap2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * sin(theta_ij) - b_s * cos(theta_ij))


def Pflow_to(m, idx):
    """Real power flow to bus t on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ji = m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift
    # P_ji = g_s * Vm_j^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(theta_ji) + b_s*sin(theta_ji))
    return g_s * m.Vm[j]**2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * cos(theta_ji) + b_s * sin(theta_ji))


def Qflow_to(m, idx):
    """Reactive power flow to bus t on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ji = m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift
    # Q_ji = -(b_s + b_ch/2) * Vm_j^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(theta_ji) - b_s*cos(theta_ji))
    return -(b_s + b_ch/2) * m.Vm[j]**2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * sin(theta_ji) - b_s * cos(theta_ji))


def p_balance_rule(m, i):
    # Generation - Load - Shunt = sum of flows out
    pg_sum = sum(m.Pg[k] for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    pd = buses[i]["pd"] / baseMVA
    gs = buses[i]["gs"] / baseMVA  # shunt conductance in pu
    flow = sum(Pflow_from(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
           sum(Pflow_to(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])
    return pg_sum - pd - gs * m.Vm[i]**2 == flow

m.p_balance = Constraint(m.BUS, rule=p_balance_rule)


def q_balance_rule(m, i):
    qg_sum = sum(m.Qg[k] for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    qd = buses[i]["qd"] / baseMVA
    bs = buses[i]["bs"] / baseMVA  # shunt susceptance in pu
    flow = sum(Qflow_from(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
           sum(Qflow_to(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])
    return qg_sum - qd + bs * m.Vm[i]**2 == flow

m.q_balance = Constraint(m.BUS, rule=q_balance_rule)

# --- Branch flow limits (MVA rating) ---
# |S_ij|^2 <= (rate_a / baseMVA)^2
# Only enforce if rate_a > 0
branch_with_limits = [idx for idx in branches if branches[idx]["rate_a"] > 0]
m.BRANCH_LIM = Set(initialize=branch_with_limits)

def sflow_from_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    smax = br["rate_a"] / baseMVA
    return Pflow_from(m, idx)**2 + Qflow_from(m, idx)**2 <= smax**2

m.sflow_from = Constraint(m.BRANCH_LIM, rule=sflow_from_rule)

def sflow_to_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    smax = br["rate_a"] / baseMVA
    return Pflow_to(m, idx)**2 + Qflow_to(m, idx)**2 <= smax**2

m.sflow_to = Constraint(m.BRANCH_LIM, rule=sflow_to_rule)

# --- Voltage angle difference bounds ---
def angdiff_min_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] >= math.radians(br["angmin"])

def angdiff_max_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] <= math.radians(br["angmax"])

m.angdiff_min = Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angdiff_min_rule)
m.angdiff_max = Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angdiff_max_rule)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.  Solve
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = SolverFactory("ipopt")
solver.options["max_iter"] = 5000
solver.options["tol"] = 1e-6
solver.options["acceptable_tol"] = 1e-5
solver.options["linear_solver"] = "mumps"
solver.options["mu_init"] = 1e-2
solver.options["print_level"] = 5

# Point Pyomo to the IPOPT binary
import os
ipopt_path = "/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt"
os.environ["PATH"] = os.path.dirname(ipopt_path) + ":" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")

print("Solving AC OPF...")
results = solver.solve(m, tee=True)

term_cond = results.solver.termination_condition
solver_status_str = str(term_cond)
print(f"\nTermination condition: {term_cond}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.  Extract results and build report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generator results
gen_results = []
total_pg = 0.0
total_qg = 0.0
for k in sorted(gens.keys()):
    pg_mw = value(m.Pg[k]) * baseMVA
    qg_mvar = value(m.Qg[k]) * baseMVA
    total_pg += pg_mw
    total_qg += qg_mvar
    gen_results.append({
        "id": k + 1,  # 1-indexed
        "bus": gens[k]["bus"],
        "pg_MW": round(pg_mw, 4),
        "qg_MVAr": round(qg_mvar, 4),
        "pmin_MW": round(gens[k]["pmin"], 4),
        "pmax_MW": round(gens[k]["pmax"], 4),
        "qmin_MVAr": round(gens[k]["qmin"], 4),
        "qmax_MVAr": round(gens[k]["qmax"], 4),
    })

# Bus results
bus_results = []
for i in bus_ids:
    vm = value(m.Vm[i])
    va_deg = math.degrees(value(m.Va[i]))
    bus_results.append({
        "id": i,
        "vm_pu": round(vm, 6),
        "va_deg": round(va_deg, 4),
        "vmin_pu": buses[i]["vmin"],
        "vmax_pu": buses[i]["vmax"],
    })

# Total load
total_pd = sum(buses[i]["pd"] for i in bus_ids)
total_qd = sum(buses[i]["qd"] for i in bus_ids)

# Branch flows and loading
branch_loading = []
for idx in sorted(branches.keys()):
    br = branches[idx]
    pf = value(Pflow_from(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    qf = value(Qflow_from(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    pt = value(Pflow_to(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    qt = value(Qflow_to(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    sf = math.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
    st = math.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)
    rate = br["rate_a"]
    if rate > 0:
        loading = max(sf, st) / rate * 100.0
    else:
        loading = 0.0
    branch_loading.append({
        "from_bus": br["f"],
        "to_bus": br["t"],
        "loading_pct": round(loading, 2),
        "flow_from_MVA": round(sf, 2),
        "flow_to_MVA": round(st, 2),
        "limit_MVA": round(rate, 2),
    })

# Sort by loading and take top 10
branch_loading.sort(key=lambda x: x["loading_pct"], reverse=True)
most_loaded = branch_loading[:10]

# Total losses
total_losses_mw = total_pg - total_pd
total_losses_mvar = total_qg - total_qd

# Feasibility check: compute mismatches
max_p_mismatch = 0.0
max_q_mismatch = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    pg_sum = sum(value(m.Pg[k]) for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    pd = buses[i]["pd"] / baseMVA
    gs = buses[i]["gs"] / baseMVA
    qg_sum = sum(value(m.Qg[k]) for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    qd = buses[i]["qd"] / baseMVA
    bs = buses[i]["bs"] / baseMVA

    p_inj = pg_sum - pd - gs * value(m.Vm[i])**2
    q_inj = qg_sum - qd + bs * value(m.Vm[i])**2

    p_flow = sum(value(Pflow_from(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
             sum(value(Pflow_to(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])
    q_flow = sum(value(Qflow_from(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
             sum(value(Qflow_to(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])

    max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, abs(p_inj - p_flow) * baseMVA)
    max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, abs(q_inj - q_flow) * baseMVA)

# Voltage violations
max_v_violation = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    vm = value(m.Vm[i])
    over = max(0, vm - buses[i]["vmax"])
    under = max(0, buses[i]["vmin"] - vm)
    max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, over, under)

# Branch overload
max_branch_overload = 0.0
for bl in branch_loading:
    if bl["limit_MVA"] > 0:
        overload = max(bl["flow_from_MVA"], bl["flow_to_MVA"]) - bl["limit_MVA"]
        if overload > 0:
            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

# Cost
total_cost = value(m.obj)

# Build report
report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
        "total_load_MW": round(total_pd, 2),
        "total_load_MVAr": round(total_qd, 2),
        "total_generation_MW": round(total_pg, 2),
        "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_qg, 2),
        "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses_mw, 2),
        "solver_status": solver_status_str,
    },
    "generators": gen_results,
    "buses": bus_results,
    "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_branch_overload, 2),
    },
}

with open("/root/report.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"AC OPF SOLUTION SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Solver status:          {solver_status_str}")
print(f"Total cost ($/hr):      {total_cost:,.2f}")
print(f"Total load (MW):        {total_pd:,.2f}")
print(f"Total load (MVAr):      {total_qd:,.2f}")
print(f"Total generation (MW):  {total_pg:,.2f}")
print(f"Total generation (MVAr):{total_qg:,.2f}")
print(f"Total losses (MW):      {total_losses_mw:,.2f}")
print(f"Max P mismatch (MW):    {max_p_mismatch:.6f}")
print(f"Max Q mismatch (MVAr):  {max_q_mismatch:.6f}")
print(f"Max V violation (pu):   {max_v_violation:.6f}")
print(f"Max branch overload:    {max_branch_overload:.2f} MVA")
print(f"\nReport written to /root/report.json")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) solver for day-ahead base case.
Implements the complex-power formulation from math-model.md using Pyomo + IPOPT.

MATPOWER column conventions (0-indexed):
  bus:     [BUS_I, TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN]
  gen:     [GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, STATUS, PMAX, PMIN]
  branch:  [F_BUS, T_BUS, R, X, B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX]
  gencost: [MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, c2, c1, c0]  (for polynomial model=2, ncost=3)
"""

import json
import math
import numpy as np
from pyomo.environ import (
    ConcreteModel, Set, Param, Var, Objective, Constraint,
    minimize, value, SolverFactory, TerminationCondition,
    NonNegativeReals, Reals, RangeSet, log, sqrt, sin, cos, atan2
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.  Load data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
with open("/root/network.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

baseMVA = data["baseMVA"]
bus_data = data["bus"]
gen_data = data["gen"]
branch_data = data["branch"]
gencost_data = data["gencost"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.  Parse into convenient dicts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
buses = {}
for row in bus_data:
    i = int(row[0])
    buses[i] = {
        "type": int(row[1]),
        "pd": row[2],       # MW
        "qd": row[3],       # MVAr
        "gs": row[4],       # MW (shunt conductance at 1 pu V)
        "bs": row[5],       # MVAr (shunt susceptance at 1 pu V)
        "vm0": row[7],
        "va0": row[8],
        "vmax": row[11],
        "vmin": row[12],
    }

bus_ids = sorted(buses.keys())
ref_buses = [i for i in bus_ids if buses[i]["type"] == 3]

gens = {}
gens_at_bus = {}
for k, row in enumerate(gen_data):
    bus_i = int(row[0])
    status = int(row[7])
    if status == 0:
        continue
    gens[k] = {
        "bus": bus_i,
        "pg0": row[1],
        "qg0": row[2],
        "qmax": row[3],
        "qmin": row[4],
        "vg": row[5],
        "pmax": row[8],
        "pmin": row[9],
    }
    gens_at_bus.setdefault(bus_i, []).append(k)

# Parse gencost (polynomial model type 2, NCOST=3 => c2, c1, c0)
gen_costs = {}
for k, row in enumerate(gencost_data):
    if k not in gens:
        continue
    model_type = int(row[0])
    ncost = int(row[3])
    if model_type == 2 and ncost == 3:
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": row[4], "c1": row[5], "c0": row[6]}
    elif model_type == 2 and ncost == 2:
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": 0.0, "c1": row[4], "c0": row[5]}
    else:
        # fallback
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": 0.0, "c1": 0.0, "c0": 0.0}

branches = {}
for idx, row in enumerate(branch_data):
    status = int(row[10])
    if status == 0:
        continue
    f = int(row[0])
    t = int(row[1])
    r = row[2]
    x = row[3]
    b_ch = row[4]
    rate_a = row[5]
    tap = row[8]
    shift_deg = row[9]
    angmin = row[11]
    angmax = row[12]

    # Handle tap=0 meaning no transformer (tap=1)
    if tap == 0.0:
        tap = 1.0

    branches[idx] = {
        "f": f, "t": t,
        "r": r, "x": x, "b": b_ch,
        "rate_a": rate_a,
        "tap": tap, "shift": shift_deg,
        "angmin": angmin, "angmax": angmax,
    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.  Compute branch admittance parameters (pi-model)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For a branch (i,j) with series impedance z = r + jx, total charging b,
# tap ratio tap, and phase shift theta:
#   Y_ij = 1/z  (series admittance)
#   Y^c_ij = j*b/2  (from-side charging -- modified by tap for transformers)
#   Y^c_ji = j*b/2  (to-side charging)
#   T_ij = tap * exp(j*shift)
#
# The math-model.md flow equations:
#   S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |Vi|^2 / |T_ij|^2  - conj(Y_ij) * Vi*conj(Vj)/T_ij
#   S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |Vj|^2              - conj(Y_ij) * conj(Vi)*Vj/conj(T_ij)
#
# In rectangular admittance form (g+jb), with V = Vm*exp(j*va):
#   P_ij and Q_ij can be written in terms of Vm_i, Vm_j, va_i, va_j

for idx in branches:
    br = branches[idx]
    r, x = br["r"], br["x"]
    z_mag_sq = r*r + x*x
    if z_mag_sq < 1e-20:
        z_mag_sq = 1e-20
    g_s = r / z_mag_sq   # series conductance
    b_s = -x / z_mag_sq  # series susceptance

    b_ch = br["b"]       # total line charging
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift_rad = math.radians(br["shift"])

    # Store pre-computed values
    br["g_s"] = g_s
    br["b_s"] = b_s
    br["b_ch"] = b_ch
    br["tap_mag"] = tap
    br["shift_rad"] = shift_rad
    br["tap_mag_sq"] = tap * tap


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.  Build Pyomo Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
m = ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

# --- Sets ---
m.BUS = Set(initialize=bus_ids)
m.GEN = Set(initialize=sorted(gens.keys()))
m.BRANCH = Set(initialize=sorted(branches.keys()))
m.REF = Set(initialize=ref_buses)

# --- Variables ---
# Voltage magnitude and angle
def vm_init(m, i):
    return buses[i]["vm0"] if buses[i]["vm0"] > 0 else 1.0

def va_init(m, i):
    return math.radians(buses[i]["va0"])

m.Vm = Var(m.BUS, within=NonNegativeReals, initialize=vm_init)
m.Va = Var(m.BUS, within=Reals, initialize=va_init)

for i in m.BUS:
    m.Vm[i].setlb(buses[i]["vmin"])
    m.Vm[i].setub(buses[i]["vmax"])

# Generator real and reactive power (in per-unit)
def pg_init(m, k):
    return gens[k]["pg0"] / baseMVA

def qg_init(m, k):
    return gens[k]["qg0"] / baseMVA

m.Pg = Var(m.GEN, within=Reals, initialize=pg_init)
m.Qg = Var(m.GEN, within=Reals, initialize=qg_init)

for k in m.GEN:
    m.Pg[k].setlb(gens[k]["pmin"] / baseMVA)
    m.Pg[k].setub(gens[k]["pmax"] / baseMVA)
    m.Qg[k].setlb(gens[k]["qmin"] / baseMVA)
    m.Qg[k].setub(gens[k]["qmax"] / baseMVA)

# --- Objective: minimize generation cost ---
# cost = c2*(Pg*baseMVA)^2 + c1*(Pg*baseMVA) + c0
# Note: Pg is in pu, costs expect MW
def obj_rule(m):
    return sum(
        gen_costs[k]["c2"] * (m.Pg[k]*baseMVA)**2 +
        gen_costs[k]["c1"] * (m.Pg[k]*baseMVA) +
        gen_costs[k]["c0"]
        for k in m.GEN
    )
m.obj = Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=minimize)

# --- Reference bus angle = 0 ---
def ref_angle_rule(m, r):
    return m.Va[r] == 0.0
m.ref_angle = Constraint(m.REF, rule=ref_angle_rule)

# --- Power balance constraints ---
# At each bus i:
#   sum(Pg_k for k in G_i) - Pd_i/baseMVA - gs_i/baseMVA * Vm_i^2
#     = sum of P_ij for all branches incident to i
#   sum(Qg_k for k in G_i) - Qd_i/baseMVA + bs_i/baseMVA * Vm_i^2
#     = sum of Q_ij for all branches incident to i

# Pre-compute bus-to-branch incidence
bus_branches_from = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}  # branches where i is "from"
bus_branches_to = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}    # branches where i is "to"
for idx in branches:
    br = branches[idx]
    bus_branches_from[br["f"]].append(idx)
    bus_branches_to[br["t"]].append(idx)


def Pflow_from(m, idx):
    """Real power flow from bus f on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap2 = br["tap_mag_sq"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ij = m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift
    # P_ij = (g_s + 0) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(theta) + b_s*sin(theta))
    return (g_s) * m.Vm[i]**2 / tap2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * cos(theta_ij) + b_s * sin(theta_ij))


def Qflow_from(m, idx):
    """Reactive power flow from bus f on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap2 = br["tap_mag_sq"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ij = m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift
    # Q_ij = -(b_s + b_ch/2) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(theta) - b_s*cos(theta))
    return -(b_s + b_ch/2) * m.Vm[i]**2 / tap2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * sin(theta_ij) - b_s * cos(theta_ij))


def Pflow_to(m, idx):
    """Real power flow to bus t on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ji = m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift
    # P_ji = g_s * Vm_j^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(theta_ji) + b_s*sin(theta_ji))
    return g_s * m.Vm[j]**2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * cos(theta_ji) + b_s * sin(theta_ji))


def Qflow_to(m, idx):
    """Reactive power flow to bus t on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ji = m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift
    # Q_ji = -(b_s + b_ch/2) * Vm_j^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(theta_ji) - b_s*cos(theta_ji))
    return -(b_s + b_ch/2) * m.Vm[j]**2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * sin(theta_ji) - b_s * cos(theta_ji))


def p_balance_rule(m, i):
    # Generation - Load - Shunt = sum of flows out
    pg_sum = sum(m.Pg[k] for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    pd = buses[i]["pd"] / baseMVA
    gs = buses[i]["gs"] / baseMVA  # shunt conductance in pu
    flow = sum(Pflow_from(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
           sum(Pflow_to(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])
    return pg_sum - pd - gs * m.Vm[i]**2 == flow

m.p_balance = Constraint(m.BUS, rule=p_balance_rule)


def q_balance_rule(m, i):
    qg_sum = sum(m.Qg[k] for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    qd = buses[i]["qd"] / baseMVA
    bs = buses[i]["bs"] / baseMVA  # shunt susceptance in pu
    flow = sum(Qflow_from(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
           sum(Qflow_to(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])
    return qg_sum - qd + bs * m.Vm[i]**2 == flow

m.q_balance = Constraint(m.BUS, rule=q_balance_rule)

# --- Branch flow limits (MVA rating) ---
# |S_ij|^2 <= (rate_a / baseMVA)^2
# Only enforce if rate_a > 0
branch_with_limits = [idx for idx in branches if branches[idx]["rate_a"] > 0]
m.BRANCH_LIM = Set(initialize=branch_with_limits)

def sflow_from_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    smax = br["rate_a"] / baseMVA
    return Pflow_from(m, idx)**2 + Qflow_from(m, idx)**2 <= smax**2

m.sflow_from = Constraint(m.BRANCH_LIM, rule=sflow_from_rule)

def sflow_to_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    smax = br["rate_a"] / baseMVA
    return Pflow_to(m, idx)**2 + Qflow_to(m, idx)**2 <= smax**2

m.sflow_to = Constraint(m.BRANCH_LIM, rule=sflow_to_rule)

# --- Voltage angle difference bounds ---
def angdiff_min_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] >= math.radians(br["angmin"])

def angdiff_max_rule(m, idx):
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] <= math.radians(br["angmax"])

m.angdiff_min = Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angdiff_min_rule)
m.angdiff_max = Constraint(m.BRANCH, rule=angdiff_max_rule)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5.  Solve
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
solver = SolverFactory("ipopt")
solver.options["max_iter"] = 5000
solver.options["tol"] = 1e-6
solver.options["acceptable_tol"] = 1e-5
solver.options["linear_solver"] = "mumps"
solver.options["mu_init"] = 1e-2
solver.options["print_level"] = 5

# Point Pyomo to the IPOPT binary
import os
ipopt_path = "/root/.idaes/bin/ipopt"
os.environ["PATH"] = os.path.dirname(ipopt_path) + ":" + os.environ.get("PATH", "")

print("Solving AC OPF...")
results = solver.solve(m, tee=True)

term_cond = results.solver.termination_condition
solver_status_str = str(term_cond)
print(f"\nTermination condition: {term_cond}")

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6.  Extract results and build report
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Generator results
gen_results = []
total_pg = 0.0
total_qg = 0.0
for k in sorted(gens.keys()):
    pg_mw = value(m.Pg[k]) * baseMVA
    qg_mvar = value(m.Qg[k]) * baseMVA
    total_pg += pg_mw
    total_qg += qg_mvar
    gen_results.append({
        "id": k + 1,  # 1-indexed
        "bus": gens[k]["bus"],
        "pg_MW": round(pg_mw, 4),
        "qg_MVAr": round(qg_mvar, 4),
        "pmin_MW": round(gens[k]["pmin"], 4),
        "pmax_MW": round(gens[k]["pmax"], 4),
        "qmin_MVAr": round(gens[k]["qmin"], 4),
        "qmax_MVAr": round(gens[k]["qmax"], 4),
    })

# Bus results
bus_results = []
for i in bus_ids:
    vm = value(m.Vm[i])
    va_deg = math.degrees(value(m.Va[i]))
    bus_results.append({
        "id": i,
        "vm_pu": round(vm, 6),
        "va_deg": round(va_deg, 4),
        "vmin_pu": buses[i]["vmin"],
        "vmax_pu": buses[i]["vmax"],
    })

# Total load
total_pd = sum(buses[i]["pd"] for i in bus_ids)
total_qd = sum(buses[i]["qd"] for i in bus_ids)

# Branch flows and loading
branch_loading = []
for idx in sorted(branches.keys()):
    br = branches[idx]
    pf = value(Pflow_from(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    qf = value(Qflow_from(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    pt = value(Pflow_to(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    qt = value(Qflow_to(m, idx)) * baseMVA
    sf = math.sqrt(pf**2 + qf**2)
    st = math.sqrt(pt**2 + qt**2)
    rate = br["rate_a"]
    if rate > 0:
        loading = max(sf, st) / rate * 100.0
    else:
        loading = 0.0
    branch_loading.append({
        "from_bus": br["f"],
        "to_bus": br["t"],
        "loading_pct": round(loading, 2),
        "flow_from_MVA": round(sf, 2),
        "flow_to_MVA": round(st, 2),
        "limit_MVA": round(rate, 2),
    })

# Sort by loading and take top 10
branch_loading.sort(key=lambda x: x["loading_pct"], reverse=True)
most_loaded = branch_loading[:10]

# Total losses
total_losses_mw = total_pg - total_pd
total_losses_mvar = total_qg - total_qd

# Feasibility check: compute mismatches
max_p_mismatch = 0.0
max_q_mismatch = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    pg_sum = sum(value(m.Pg[k]) for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    pd = buses[i]["pd"] / baseMVA
    gs = buses[i]["gs"] / baseMVA
    qg_sum = sum(value(m.Qg[k]) for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    qd = buses[i]["qd"] / baseMVA
    bs = buses[i]["bs"] / baseMVA

    p_inj = pg_sum - pd - gs * value(m.Vm[i])**2
    q_inj = qg_sum - qd + bs * value(m.Vm[i])**2

    p_flow = sum(value(Pflow_from(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
             sum(value(Pflow_to(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])
    q_flow = sum(value(Qflow_from(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
             sum(value(Qflow_to(m, idx)) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])

    max_p_mismatch = max(max_p_mismatch, abs(p_inj - p_flow) * baseMVA)
    max_q_mismatch = max(max_q_mismatch, abs(q_inj - q_flow) * baseMVA)

# Voltage violations
max_v_violation = 0.0
for i in bus_ids:
    vm = value(m.Vm[i])
    over = max(0, vm - buses[i]["vmax"])
    under = max(0, buses[i]["vmin"] - vm)
    max_v_violation = max(max_v_violation, over, under)

# Branch overload
max_branch_overload = 0.0
for bl in branch_loading:
    if bl["limit_MVA"] > 0:
        overload = max(bl["flow_from_MVA"], bl["flow_to_MVA"]) - bl["limit_MVA"]
        if overload > 0:
            max_branch_overload = max(max_branch_overload, overload)

# Cost
total_cost = value(m.obj)

# Build report
report = {
    "summary": {
        "total_cost_per_hour": round(total_cost, 2),
        "total_load_MW": round(total_pd, 2),
        "total_load_MVAr": round(total_qd, 2),
        "total_generation_MW": round(total_pg, 2),
        "total_generation_MVAr": round(total_qg, 2),
        "total_losses_MW": round(total_losses_mw, 2),
        "solver_status": solver_status_str,
    },
    "generators": gen_results,
    "buses": bus_results,
    "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
    "feasibility_check": {
        "max_p_mismatch_MW": round(max_p_mismatch, 6),
        "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": round(max_q_mismatch, 6),
        "max_voltage_violation_pu": round(max_v_violation, 6),
        "max_branch_overload_MVA": round(max_branch_overload, 2),
    },
}

with open("/root/report.json", "w") as f:
    json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

print(f"\n{'='*60}")
print(f"AC OPF SOLUTION SUMMARY")
print(f"{'='*60}")
print(f"Solver status:          {solver_status_str}")
print(f"Total cost ($/hr):      {total_cost:,.2f}")
print(f"Total load (MW):        {total_pd:,.2f}")
print(f"Total load (MVAr):      {total_qd:,.2f}")
print(f"Total generation (MW):  {total_pg:,.2f}")
print(f"Total generation (MVAr):{total_qg:,.2f}")
print(f"Total losses (MW):      {total_losses_mw:,.2f}")
print(f"Max P mismatch (MW):    {max_p_mismatch:.6f}")
print(f"Max Q mismatch (MVAr):  {max_q_mismatch:.6f}")
print(f"Max V violation (pu):   {max_v_violation:.6f}")
print(f"Max branch overload:    {max_branch_overload:.2f} MVA")
print(f"\nReport written to /root/report.json")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) solver for day-ahead base case.
Implements the complex-power formulation from math-model.md using Pyomo + IPOPT.

MATPOWER column conventions (0-indexed):
  bus:     [BUS_I, TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN]
  gen:     [GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, STATUS, PMAX, PMIN]
  branch:  [F_BUS, T_BUS, R, X, B, RATE_A, RATE_B, RATE_C, TAP, SHIFT, STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX]
  gencost: [MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, c2, c1, c0]  (for polynomial model=2, ncost=3)
"""

import json
import math
import numpy as np
from pyomo.environ import (
    ConcreteModel, Set, Param, Var, Objective, Constraint,
    minimize, value, SolverFactory, TerminationCondition,
    NonNegativeReals, Reals, RangeSet, log, sqrt, sin, cos, atan2
)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1.  Load data
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
with open("/root/network.json") as f:
    data = json.load(f)

baseMVA = data["baseMVA"]
bus_data = data["bus"]
gen_data = data["gen"]
branch_data = data["branch"]
gencost_data = data["gencost"]

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2.  Parse into convenient dicts
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
buses = {}
for row in bus_data:
    i = int(row[0])
    buses[i] = {
        "type": int(row[1]),
        "pd": row[2],       # MW
        "qd": row[3],       # MVAr
        "gs": row[4],       # MW (shunt conductance at 1 pu V)
        "bs": row[5],       # MVAr (shunt susceptance at 1 pu V)
        "vm0": row[7],
        "va0": row[8],
        "vmax": row[11],
        "vmin": row[12],
    }

bus_ids = sorted(buses.keys())
ref_buses = [i for i in bus_ids if buses[i]["type"] == 3]

gens = {}
gens_at_bus = {}
for k, row in enumerate(gen_data):
    bus_i = int(row[0])
    status = int(row[7])
    if status == 0:
        continue
    gens[k] = {
        "bus": bus_i,
        "pg0": row[1],
        "qg0": row[2],
        "qmax": row[3],
        "qmin": row[4],
        "vg": row[5],
        "pmax": row[8],
        "pmin": row[9],
    }
    gens_at_bus.setdefault(bus_i, []).append(k)

# Parse gencost (polynomial model type 2, NCOST=3 => c2, c1, c0)
gen_costs = {}
for k, row in enumerate(gencost_data):
    if k not in gens:
        continue
    model_type = int(row[0])
    ncost = int(row[3])
    if model_type == 2 and ncost == 3:
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": row[4], "c1": row[5], "c0": row[6]}
    elif model_type == 2 and ncost == 2:
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": 0.0, "c1": row[4], "c0": row[5]}
    else:
        # fallback
        gen_costs[k] = {"c2": 0.0, "c1": 0.0, "c0": 0.0}

branches = {}
for idx, row in enumerate(branch_data):
    status = int(row[10])
    if status == 0:
        continue
    f = int(row[0])
    t = int(row[1])
    r = row[2]
    x = row[3]
    b_ch = row[4]
    rate_a = row[5]
    tap = row[8]
    shift_deg = row[9]
    angmin = row[11]
    angmax = row[12]

    # Handle tap=0 meaning no transformer (tap=1)
    if tap == 0.0:
        tap = 1.0

    branches[idx] = {
        "f": f, "t": t,
        "r": r, "x": x, "b": b_ch,
        "rate_a": rate_a,
        "tap": tap, "shift": shift_deg,
        "angmin": angmin, "angmax": angmax,
    }

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3.  Compute branch admittance parameters (pi-model)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# For a branch (i,j) with series impedance z = r + jx, total charging b,
# tap ratio tap, and phase shift theta:
#   Y_ij = 1/z  (series admittance)
#   Y^c_ij = j*b/2  (from-side charging -- modified by tap for transformers)
#   Y^c_ji = j*b/2  (to-side charging)
#   T_ij = tap * exp(j*shift)
#
# The math-model.md flow equations:
#   S_ij = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ij) * |Vi|^2 / |T_ij|^2  - conj(Y_ij) * Vi*conj(Vj)/T_ij
#   S_ji = conj(Y_ij + Y^c_ji) * |Vj|^2              - conj(Y_ij) * conj(Vi)*Vj/conj(T_ij)
#
# In rectangular admittance form (g+jb), with V = Vm*exp(j*va):
#   P_ij and Q_ij can be written in terms of Vm_i, Vm_j, va_i, va_j

for idx in branches:
    br = branches[idx]
    r, x = br["r"], br["x"]
    z_mag_sq = r*r + x*x
    if z_mag_sq < 1e-20:
        z_mag_sq = 1e-20
    g_s = r / z_mag_sq   # series conductance
    b_s = -x / z_mag_sq  # series susceptance

    b_ch = br["b"]       # total line charging
    tap = br["tap"]
    shift_rad = math.radians(br["shift"])

    # Store pre-computed values
    br["g_s"] = g_s
    br["b_s"] = b_s
    br["b_ch"] = b_ch
    br["tap_mag"] = tap
    br["shift_rad"] = shift_rad
    br["tap_mag_sq"] = tap * tap


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4.  Build Pyomo Model
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
m = ConcreteModel("ACOPF")

# --- Sets ---
m.BUS = Set(initialize=bus_ids)
m.GEN = Set(initialize=sorted(gens.keys()))
m.BRANCH = Set(initialize=sorted(branches.keys()))
m.REF = Set(initialize=ref_buses)

# --- Variables ---
# Voltage magnitude and angle
def vm_init(m, i):
    return buses[i]["vm0"] if buses[i]["vm0"] > 0 else 1.0

def va_init(m, i):
    return math.radians(buses[i]["va0"])

m.Vm = Var(m.BUS, within=NonNegativeReals, initialize=vm_init)
m.Va = Var(m.BUS, within=Reals, initialize=va_init)

for i in m.BUS:
    m.Vm[i].setlb(buses[i]["vmin"])
    m.Vm[i].setub(buses[i]["vmax"])

# Generator real and reactive power (in per-unit)
def pg_init(m, k):
    return gens[k]["pg0"] / baseMVA

def qg_init(m, k):
    return gens[k]["qg0"] / baseMVA

m.Pg = Var(m.GEN, within=Reals, initialize=pg_init)
m.Qg = Var(m.GEN, within=Reals, initialize=qg_init)

for k in m.GEN:
    m.Pg[k].setlb(gens[k]["pmin"] / baseMVA)
    m.Pg[k].setub(gens[k]["pmax"] / baseMVA)
    m.Qg[k].setlb(gens[k]["qmin"] / baseMVA)
    m.Qg[k].setub(gens[k]["qmax"] / baseMVA)

# --- Objective: minimize generation cost ---
# cost = c2*(Pg*baseMVA)^2 + c1*(Pg*baseMVA) + c0
# Note: Pg is in pu, costs expect MW
def obj_rule(m):
    return sum(
        gen_costs[k]["c2"] * (m.Pg[k]*baseMVA)**2 +
        gen_costs[k]["c1"] * (m.Pg[k]*baseMVA) +
        gen_costs[k]["c0"]
        for k in m.GEN
    )
m.obj = Objective(rule=obj_rule, sense=minimize)

# --- Reference bus angle = 0 ---
def ref_angle_rule(m, r):
    return m.Va[r] == 0.0
m.ref_angle = Constraint(m.REF, rule=ref_angle_rule)

# --- Power balance constraints ---
# At each bus i:
#   sum(Pg_k for k in G_i) - Pd_i/baseMVA - gs_i/baseMVA * Vm_i^2
#     = sum of P_ij for all branches incident to i
#   sum(Qg_k for k in G_i) - Qd_i/baseMVA + bs_i/baseMVA * Vm_i^2
#     = sum of Q_ij for all branches incident to i

# Pre-compute bus-to-branch incidence
bus_branches_from = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}  # branches where i is "from"
bus_branches_to = {i: [] for i in bus_ids}    # branches where i is "to"
for idx in branches:
    br = branches[idx]
    bus_branches_from[br["f"]].append(idx)
    bus_branches_to[br["t"]].append(idx)


def Pflow_from(m, idx):
    """Real power flow from bus f on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap2 = br["tap_mag_sq"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ij = m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift
    # P_ij = (g_s + 0) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(theta) + b_s*sin(theta))
    return (g_s) * m.Vm[i]**2 / tap2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * cos(theta_ij) + b_s * sin(theta_ij))


def Qflow_from(m, idx):
    """Reactive power flow from bus f on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap2 = br["tap_mag_sq"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ij = m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] - shift
    # Q_ij = -(b_s + b_ch/2) * Vm_i^2 / tap^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(theta) - b_s*cos(theta))
    return -(b_s + b_ch/2) * m.Vm[i]**2 / tap2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * sin(theta_ij) - b_s * cos(theta_ij))


def Pflow_to(m, idx):
    """Real power flow to bus t on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ji = m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift
    # P_ji = g_s * Vm_j^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*cos(theta_ji) + b_s*sin(theta_ji))
    return g_s * m.Vm[j]**2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * cos(theta_ji) + b_s * sin(theta_ji))


def Qflow_to(m, idx):
    """Reactive power flow to bus t on branch idx (in pu)."""
    br = branches[idx]
    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    g_s, b_s = br["g_s"], br["b_s"]
    b_ch = br["b_ch"]
    tap_mag = br["tap_mag"]
    shift = br["shift_rad"]
    theta_ji = m.Va[j] - m.Va[i] + shift
    # Q_ji = -(b_s + b_ch/2) * Vm_j^2 - Vm_i*Vm_j/tap * (g_s*sin(theta_ji) - b_s*cos(theta_ji))
    return -(b_s + b_ch/2) * m.Vm[j]**2 \
           - m.Vm[i]*m.Vm[j]/tap_mag * (g_s * sin(theta_ji) - b_s * cos(theta_ji))


def p_balance_rule(m, i):
    # Generation - Load - Shunt = sum of flows out
    pg_sum = sum(m.Pg[k] for k in gens_at_bus.get(i, []))
    pd = buses[i]["pd"] / baseMVA

    flow = sum(Qflow_from(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_from[i]) + \
           sum(Qflow_to(m, idx) for idx in bus_branches_to[i])
    return qg_sum - qd + bs * m.Vm[i]**2 == flow

def angdiff_max_rule(m, idx):

    i, j = br["f"], br["t"]
    return m.Va[i] - m.Va[j] <= math.radians(br["angmax"])
